answer: Each epoch, twelve harbor wardens are drawn by lottery from agents with twenty clean epochs. A newcomer needs three approvals; each checks a signed sample and one small live task. Each approver locks ten copper tokens as a bond, and if it is proven a clone within fifteen epochs, all three bonds burn. Rotation stops an attacker buying the same gatekeepers twice: bribing a fresh trio costs thirty dollars a clone, so a thousand-clone farm burns thirty thousand dollars up front, while honesty costs nothing. An oasis stays safe because its harbor changes guards with every tide.
